name: Oat Milk (Homemade)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Put oats in a blender. Blend the oats to the finest powder you can get
Add as much of the water as possible to the blender. Blend some more.
Strain the mixture into a jug, and add the rest of the water.

culture.text: Oat milk is a plant milk derived from whole oat grains by extracting the plant material with water. Oat milk has a creamy texture and mild oatmeal-like flavor, and is manufactured in various flavors, such as sweetened, unsweetened, vanilla, and chocolate.
